# EchoFootPrint

> Privacy-first browser extension that reveals cross-site tracking from 50 major ad and analytics platforms. All data stays local on the device — no accounts, no telemetry, no cloud sync.

## Pages

- [Home](https://echo-footprint.luongnv.com/): What EchoFootPrint does, how it works, dashboard views, platform coverage, FAQ.
- [Privacy Policy](https://echo-footprint.luongnv.com/privacy.html): Local-only data handling, retention, user controls and GDPR rights.

## Key facts

- [How it works](https://echo-footprint.luongnv.com/#how-it-works): Browse normally, pixels matched locally in IndexedDB, visualized instantly.
- [Views](https://echo-footprint.luongnv.com/#views): Radial graph, bipartite graph, map (opt-in geolocation), sortable data table with CSV export.
- [Platforms](https://echo-footprint.luongnv.com/#platforms): 50 supported platforms across social, search, exchanges, DSPs, mobile and data brokers.
- [FAQ](https://echo-footprint.luongnv.com/#faq): Does not block trackers; stores detections locally only; one-click wipe in Settings.
- Install: [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/pbabepaamiligomhlcmkjabhmkmaekci?utm_source=item-share-cb)
- Source and releases: [GitHub](https://github.com/luongnv89/echo-footprint)
